ISO/IEC 42001 is an international standa: ISO/IEC 42001 is an international standard that specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) within organisations. Published in December 2023, it is the world's first AI management system standard. It addresses unique AI challenges such as ethical considerations, transparency, and continuous learning.
following the same Plan-Do-Check-Act st: following the same Plan-Do-Check-Act structure as ISO 9001 and ISO 27001. It certifies that your organisation has a robust, auditable system for governing AI — policies, processes, risk assessments, and controls — not that a specific algorithm is unbiased.
